name: Bismarck
summary: Three-player Swedish trick-taking game where forehand chooses trump or misère and scores against a trick quota.
rules_text: Three players use 52 cards ranking A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2. Forehand (left of dealer) chooses contract after seeing 4 face-up cards, then all get 16 cards; forehand gets the 4 extra for 20 and discards 4 face down. Contracts are: Spel/Sang (no trump, win tricks), Pass (no trump, avoid tricks), Spader (spades trump, win tricks), Valfri (forehand chooses trump suit, win tricks). A full match is 12 deals, each player is forehand 4 times and must play each contract once. Play clockwise, must follow suit if able, may play any card otherwise. Highest trump wins, otherwise highest of led suit. Scoring: In win contracts forehand quota is 8, others 4 each; score +1 per trick over quota, -1 per under, 0 if exact. In Pass forehand quota 4, others 6; +1 per trick under quota, -1 per over. Scores sum to zero.
